objective: Estimate within-case scoring stability and presentation-order sensitivity without changing the judged texts, packet, rubric, or model configuration between order arms.

required_invariants: Retain each original X/Y draft byte-for-byte and bind both to a shared exact-byte digest.
Retain the same packet, judge prompt, rubric, model revision, generation parameters and tool policy in both arms.
Run at least two replicate pairs per case; each pair has one fresh isolated X_then_Y context and one fresh isolated Y_then_X context.
Present the same two drafts in each replicate pair; randomize the execution order of the four fresh contexts and record the allocation seed privately.
Use neutral draft identifiers; do not reveal R1 scores, preferences, declared assignments or answer keys to the judge.
Preserve raw model output and raw annotation before any source adjudication or correction.
Record failed calls, refusals, timeouts and unresolved source checks without deleting or regenerating them silently.
primary_descriptive_measures: within-case X-minus-Y score-gap shift between orders
per-dimension mean absolute score change for each draft, averaged within case before across-case summary
unresolved source-check counts by W4 state
analysis_limits: Do not treat dimensions, drafts or repeated judge calls as independent cases.
Do not calculate population claims or superiority/equivalence tests from this protocol alone.
Report denominators, failed/missing pairs and case-level values before aggregate summaries.

separate_calibration_run.rule: Source adjudication and any revised rubric must use a different run ID and packet. Never combine those scores with the order-only comparison.

resumption_gate: Obtain authorized exact X/Y draft bytes and source packet bytes, or explicitly create a separately labeled prospective replacement study.
Obtain original prompt, rubric and judge model/settings records. Unknown historical fields stay null; do not reconstruct them.
Freeze the current prompt, model revision/settings, allocation procedure, failure handling and analysis script before judging.
Keep the key, R1 scores and declared condition assignments outside the judge context until raw outputs and annotations are frozen.
human_evidence: not supplied by this model-only protocol
